text:
A light ray travelling in air hits the surface of a transparent medium.
The speed of light in air is greater than the speed of light in the medium.
What happens to the ray?
A
The ray is refracted with an angle of refraction that is greater than the angle of incidence.
B
The ray is totally internally reflected.
C
The ray refracts away from the normal.
D
The ray refracts towards the normal.
